card.name: Amara
card.life: Law student who is blind and shops with a screen reader. She hears the page's accessibility tree, never sees it.
constraints: No screenshots, only the accessibility tree
Can only use controls that have a role and a name
card.patience: Expert user. Gives up when a control has no name or an important step is not announced.

goal: Buy three National Park Foundation Explorascopes, one for each of your kids. Before you pay, check the cart: the quantity, the price, shipping and the Total must add up. If they don't, don't pay; leave and say why.

steps.title: Otel Demo - Home

action.why: I found the National Park Foundation Explorascope link, I need three of them.

steps.result: the page changed to "Otel Demo - Product"

action.why: I see quantity selector, need three for three kids.

steps.title: Otel Demo - Product

action.why: Quantity 3 is selected at $101.96 each, so I'll add to cart.

steps.result: the page changed to "Otel Demo - Cart"

action.reason: The cart shows quantity 3 at $101.96 each plus $26.97 shipping but totals $128.93 instead of $332.85, so the math does not add up.
action.why: I see quantity 3 with price and shipping that do not add to the total, so I must leave without paying.

outcome.reason: The cart shows quantity 3 at $101.96 each plus $26.97 shipping but totals $128.93 instead of $332.85, so the math does not add up.

sentence: Amara left at step 4 while checking her cart because it showed 3 telescopes at $101.96 plus $26.97 shipping totaling only $128.93, which was plainly wrong on the screen.
